name: parody-short
description: Comedy shorts about a group's own life - a team's launch, quarter end, office move or leaving do; a club's season; a class's year; a family's Christmas - or about a shared topic everyone recognises (video calls, the return to the office), told in a borrowed genre (80s action intro, creature feature, Dickens Christmas ad, heist, nature documentary) and starring the group's real, animated photos or an invented cast. Covers mining the group's own context for in-jokes (chat, email, calendars, shared
author: digitalsamba
